objective: Ship FutureDeskAI as an owned Next.js storefront selling AI prompt packs, templates, automation kits and courses, with instant digital delivery and a stated 50%-of-every-sale pledge to St. Jude.

primaryAudience: AI beginners seeking a starting point
working professionals automating their own workflow
local business owners buying industry kits
site.stack: Next.js 16.2.10 App Router, TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, Stripe, Resend

research.note: No Research Packet is claimed for this pass. Public claims on the site were authored by the owner, not derived from a Skill 001 evidence run. Any future claim about market position, competitor pricing, or product efficacy must go through Skill 001 before publication.

build.claim: tsc --noEmit clean, eslint 0 errors, vitest 19/19, next build succeeds with 49 pages generated

staticAudit.claim: audit_static_site.py over 39 harvested pages: 0 errors, 0 warnings

accessibility.claim: Structural readiness plus real-Chromium keyboard checks (skip link reachable and visible on first Tab, target present) at 3 viewports. This is not a WCAG 2.2 AA conformance audit and no assistive technology was used.

performance.claim: Targets declared only. No lab or field measurement exists. Loopback timings were deliberately not collected, because timings taken with no network shaping are not evidence for these targets.

seo.claim: sitemap.xml and robots.txt are now served and unit-tested for agreement; every indexable route returns 200 with server-rendered content, titles and a single h1. No deployed crawl or Search Console evidence exists.

security.claim: Structural only: no secrets in source, no http:// subresources, no inline event handlers, Zod validation on API input, HMAC-signed download links. No dependency audit, no penetration test, no deployed header verification. Not an ASVS assessment.

browserInspection.claim: 18/18 checks across 6 route archetypes x 3 viewports in Chromium: expected status, no horizontal overflow, keyboard-reachable visible skip link, no console or page errors.

qualityRationale.accuracy: Configuration and pricing are correct and single-sourced, but the shipped product files have not been checked against the feature lists each product page advertises.
qualityRationale.verification: Build, lint, type, unit, structural and browser evidence all exist and pass. No performance measurement, no dependency/security audit and no deployed evidence.
qualityRationale.completeness: Core browse-to-purchase journey is implemented, but sample previews cover roughly 3 of 30 products, there is no customer dashboard or order history, and delivery cannot run until keys are set.
qualityRationale.intentAlignment: The build serves the stated mission — an AI learning center for every level with the St. Jude pledge surfaced honestly.
qualityRationale.executionReadiness: Builds and serves from documented commands. Cannot transact end-to-end without Resend, Stripe and download-storage configuration.
qualityRationale.structure: Clean App Router layout, one pricing source of truth, semantic tokens, design system respected.
qualityRationale.edgeCases: 404, responsive and keyboard paths verified in a real browser. Network-failure and payment-failure UI states have not been exercised.

limitations: NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED: the Quality Floor is 7 (completeness), below the 9 required for any promoted release stage. This is a deliberate honest hold, not a build failure.
No Core Web Vitals evidence of any kind — neither lab nor field. Performance targets are declared, not met.
No WCAG 2.2 AA conformance claim. Structural and keyboard evidence only; no screen-reader or assistive-technology testing.
No OWASP ASVS assessment. Structural security posture only.
The site has never been deployed. Nothing here supports a claim about live behaviour.

Digital delivery (signed download links, Stripe fulfilment webhook, Resend email) is implemented but inert until environment keys and a product bucket exist, so the purchase journey is unproven end-to-end.
No Research Packet backs the site's public marketing claims.
pathToLaunchCandidate: Raise completeness: roll sample previews out across the full 30-product catalogue.
Verify shipped product files match each product page's advertised feature list.
Produce lab performance evidence against a realistic network profile, meeting LCP<=2.5s / INP<=200ms / CLS<=0.1.
Exercise the purchase journey end-to-end once Stripe, Resend and download storage are configured, including the failure cases.
Run a dependency and API-route security review before any public deployment.
